sources.citation: WALS Online (Dryer & Haspelmath eds.), CLDF values for language 'aiz' Aizi (source Herault-1971).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Only segmental features 1A-12A plus 18A, 19A coded; no 13A (tone) and no 14A-17A (stress) codings for Aizi. StressTyp2 archive held by the project has no Aizi entry.

sources.citation: Vogler, Pierre. 2024. La classification de l'aizi (Cote d'Ivoire, groupe kru, Niger-Congo). ms., HAL hal-04627162, 9 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Treats only the Tiegba (Tiagba) variety; lexical and grammatical correspondences with Grebo/Tepo; mentions the imperfective vowel 'traitee comme une voyelle non intonee' but nothing on word stress or accent placement.

sources.citation: Vogler, Pierre. 2017 [v2 2020]. Contribution a la classification des langues kru (Niger-Congo). ms., HAL hal-01574391, 74 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Comparative-historical Kru study; sec. 3.40-3.50 treat aizi (parler de Tiegba, data from Herault 1971a/b). Kru tone systems described generally (sec. 2.4: 3 or 4 registers). No statement on stress/accent in Aizi; 'accent' occurs only in the idiom 'mettre l'accent sur'.

sources.citation: Boone, Douglas; Silue Lamine; MaryAnne Augustin. 2002. L'utilisation du francais et de l'adioukrou par les Aizi. SIL Electronic Survey Reports 2002-047.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Sociolinguistic survey of the three Aizi languages; no phonology; bibliography names Herault 1971 and Marchese & Hook 1983.

sources.citation: Maddieson, Ian & Kristin Precoda. UPSID record 4131 AIZI (web interface H. Reetz, Univ. Frankfurt); source Herault 1971.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Second-hand digest of Herault 1971. Comment: 'Vowel harmony based on tongue root position is prevalent in Aizi. /a/ is neutral and /i,e,o,u/ are opposed to the remaining vowels. Aizi is tonal but the number of tones is uncertain.' Nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Marchese, Lynell & Ann Hook. 1983. Enquete dialectale en pays aizi. In G. Herault (ed.), Atlas des langues kwa de Cote d'Ivoire, tome 1, 173-179. Abidjan: ILA/ACCT.
